deviceId.description: The watch's link, as GET /v1/devices gives it (the session's id).

kind.description: garmin, wearos or applewatch, from the watch's X-LawFive-Device header; watch when it didn't say.

name.description: For people: "Garmin Venu 2", "Galaxy Watch4", "Apple Watch Series 9" ("Garmin watch" when it didn't say which).

since.description: When the watch first got the match as it has it now.

syncedAt.description: The watch's latest download, which still had the match.

upToDate.description: false when what the watch shows of the match has changed since (teams, kickoff, format, venue, officials, notes, fee), or the match is no longer scheduled: the watch's next sync brings the change, or takes the match off.

description: A match on one of the account's linked watches (SYNC-14): in the watch's latest download of its next matches.
